ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white core regions contrast with low-intensity black perimeter borders; approximate macro-distribution ratio is 65% high-intensity to 35% low-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (black) contiguous bands located along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; high-intensity (white) central surfaces exhibit isolated low-intensity circular pixel clusters on the mid-left lobe and distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation at the central axis with an approximate internal pixel angle of 40 degrees and a depth of roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth topography with peak-to-valley amplitudes varying between 2-8 pixels across the continuous boundary, particularly dense on the outer lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges with a symmetrical posterior-lateral trajectory; the trailing edge maintains a generally concave curvature towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of two distinct low-intensity circular clusters on the left ventral surface and one on the right distal tip, contrasting against the high-intensity background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serrations along the trailing edge consistent with accumulated minor tissue loss or structural weathering.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in the width of the black trailing-edge border, which appears significantly thicker and more mottled on the right lobe compared to the left.
